> Merging [#12836](https://codecov.io/gh/pingcap/tidb/pull/12836?src=pr&el=desc) into [master](https://codecov.io/gh/pingcap/tidb/commit/8ed2684e739b9f87e608e33eac0efe82dcaed801?src=pr&el=desc) will **decrease** coverage by `0.0261%`.

Thanks for your contribution. The _tidb_rowid exists only when the table's primary key is not an integer or the table doesn't have a primary key. 
```
mysql> create table t (_tidb_rowid int, primary key (_tidb_rowid));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> select * from t;
Empty set (0.00 sec)
```
We need to discuss how to deal with _tidb_rowid

@zhongzc Please address the comments above. Can you add an error like `ErrUnsupportedReservedWord` in [ddl.go](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/875873b7ca4267c0bbb2e4fe31c1561dea3f495d/ddl/ddl.go#L143)?
@zhongzc PR closed due to no update for a long time. Feel free to reopen it anytime.

issue_context.title: Duplicate column error when `_tidb_rowid` as column name
comments: hi @zhongzc , thanks for reporting! We'll fix this issue soon.

Confirming this issue still exists in master:
```sql
drop table if exists t;
create table t (_tidb_rowid int);
select * from t;
```
